Correspondence/policy alternatives have individual correct SOURCE references in all runs.
Identity/property are model proposals, not independently proved entailment.
The backend cannot detect source alternatives omitted from the output.
NA/review noise and signer inference remain; none of these is approved for rendering.

One call per run, no retries; fixture/gold unchanged and gold excluded from prompt.
